adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces sync-mode branches that will cause runtime breakage, and the finding’s “TypeErrors / wrapper-storage corruption” claims are verifiable from the code changes. (1) `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a `fetch` `Response` in sync mode, but multiple callers assume an Axios-like `{ data: ... }` shape: e.g. Google Calendar does `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token;` which will be `undefined` for a `Response` (TypeError) (`packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`). Zoho Bigin and Zoho CRM also read `.data` off the return value (`packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`). (2) `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns a Zod `safeParse` result object, but Google Calendar stores that entire result as the credential `key` (`const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...); data: { key }`), corrupting persisted credential structure (`packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`). No tests are added in this diff to catch these issues.
